verdict.rationale: Elastic explicitly advertises 'official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch' (elastic-docs-10) and has an official MCP server (elastic-probe-4/elastic-docs-28), which are agent-oriented resources, but direct probes show no llms.txt or docs.md file exists (elastic-probe-1, elastic-probe-2), so the specific story of pointing an agent at llms.txt is not supported. Missing for 10: a working llms.txt/docs.md endpoint, and any first-party documentation detailing the 'skills' content or how an agent consumes it.
